facts.fact: 1999 年新年前夜，Emily 穿仿毛阿富汗大衣在利兹站下车。
facts.anchor: Emily stepped off the train at Leeds railway station, feeling grown up in her faux fur-lined Afghan coat.

facts.fact: 她牛仔裤口袋里揣着 Aiden 的信。
facts.anchor: In her jeans pocket, she had Aiden’s letter, safely tucked in its envelope.

facts.fact: 她推测 Aiden 从大学系统查到了她家地址。
facts.anchor: He must have looked up her home address in the university system.

facts.fact: 信里说世上没有别人比她更想一起迎接千禧年。
facts.anchor: Believe me when I say there is nobody in the world with whom I would rather see in this millennium.

facts.fact: 父亲把信递给她，没有问是谁寄的。
facts.anchor: He didn’t ask who it was from, and she didn’t volunteer the information.

facts.fact: 父亲只说信上有她的名字，投来极短的一瞥。
facts.anchor: ‘This has your name on it, sweetheart,’ he said, shooting the briefest of questioning glances at her.

facts.fact: Alice 指责 Emily 一分钱房租没付，还摆出房主欠她的姿态。
facts.anchor: ‘My problem is you still haven’t paid me a penny, and yet you flounce in like I owe you the right to be here.’

facts.fact: Emily 当众辱骂 Alice，让她跟 Gareth 上床放松。
facts.anchor: ‘Why don’t you let Gareth fuck you? Then perhaps you’d chill out a bit and give us all a break.’

facts.fact: 她把抽屉里剩下的安非他命倒进手心舔掉。
facts.anchor: she tipped the remaining speed into her hand, licked it off

facts.fact: 她计划装醉昏睡，等室友出门后再清醒赴约。
facts.anchor: If she was just wasted enough, she could fake passing out in her bedroom.

facts.fact: 她当着 JJ 的面说“如果那是你的真名”。
